e.summary: **aegis-elasticity-governance**（`SebastianGarrido2790/AEGIS`，**逐字全称** Actuarial Elasticity & Governance Intelligence System**）**是一个**受治理的智能体平台****——**逐字自述**「**A governed agentic platform that recommends personal auto insurance premium adjustments by combining causal elasticity estimation, RAG-grounded regulatory compliance validation, and financial impact projection — escalating to a human underwriter whenever a recommendation falls outside pre-approved bounds.**」**，**并逐字限定用途**「**never as an autonomous rate publisher**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-13、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE.txt` 逐字** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 SebastianGarrido2790`**）**；**tarball 131 条路径**（**`src/` 49、**`reports/` 内 18 份文档、**`tests/` 14 个 `.py`、**`data_contracts/` 11、**另有 `Dockerfile`、**`docker-compose.yaml`、**`dvc.yaml`／`dvc.lock`、**`params.yaml`、**`pyproject.toml`、**`uv.lock`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游放进受治理的流程**」**——**数据用已收录的 [[fremtpl2]]**。**⭐⭐⭐ 两处最值得看**：**① **十条不变量**逐条编号写死**（**INV-1 至 INV-10**）**；**② **九阶段表里**已完成与计划中分开标注**，**而本次实测**对得上**：**`src/aegis/` 八个子包中**五个只有 `__init__.py`**，**全 `src/` 仅 **2,161 行 Python****。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何一步。

e.summary_en: The repository AEGIS, standing for Actuarial Elasticity and Governance Intelligence System, **is a governed agentic platform that recommends personal auto insurance premium adjustments**, described verbatim as combining causal elasticity estimation, retrieval-grounded regulatory compliance validation and financial impact projection while escalating to a human underwriter whenever a recommendation falls outside pre-approved bounds, and explicitly designed as a governed auditable decision loop rather than as an autonomous rate publisher. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **131 paths in the extracted archive**, including forty-nine under the source package, eighteen documentation reports, fourteen test modules, eleven data-contract files, a Dockerfile and compose file, data-version-control manifests, a parameter file and a locked dependency set. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream placing an upstream inside a governed process**, since it uses the pooled French motor third-party liability dataset. **Two things are worth reading**: ten numbered non-negotiable invariants are written into the readme, and the nine-phase status table separates what is complete from what is scheduled — a separation this entry was able to check, because five of the eight subpackages under the source tree contain only an empty package initialiser, with about two thousand one hundred and sixty lines of Python in the whole source tree. **Nothing was run.**
e.body:
**AEGIS**（GitHub 仓库 `SebastianGarrido2790/AEGIS`，**逐字全称** `Actuarial Elasticity & Governance Intelligence System`**）**是一个**受治理的智能体平台****，**README 逐字自述为**「**A governed agentic platform that recommends personal auto insurance premium adjustments by combining causal elasticity estimation, RAG-grounded regulatory compliance validation, and financial impact projection — escalating to a human underwriter whenever a recommendation falls outside pre-approved bounds.**」**，**并逐字写明设计对象与边界**「**Designed for actuarial and pricing analysts, underwriting teams, and compliance reviewers as a governed, auditable decision loop — never as an autonomous rate publisher.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-13、最后推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 MIT**（**`LICENSE.txt` 逐字前两行为** `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 SebastianGarrido2790`**）**；**tarball 131 条路径**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游放进受治理的流程**」**——**它把本站已收录的 [[fremtpl2]] 数据集当作**输入**，**再把结果送进一条**带人审的决策回路****。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单与源码统计实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 十条「**不可谈判**」不变量被逐条编号写死**——**逐字列出为**：**INV-1 **网关唯一性**（**任何 agent 或模块都不得直接 import 提供方 SDK，**所有大模型调用经进程内网关，**由它负责回退链、**缓存与护栏**）**；**INV-2 **单一向量库**（**同一个 Redis Stack 同时充当法规 RAG 索引与网关的语义提示缓存**）**；**INV-3 **数据契约是阻塞性的**（**弹性训练数据与法规文本在版本化或入索引之前必须通过校验套件，**契约失败即停流水线**）**；**INV-4 **不为发布而自主**（**输出止于自动批准的常规签署或核保人升级，**永不直接写入生产费率表**）**；**INV-5 **因果输出只能作为建议**（**弹性估计与老虎机建议**不得**在没有合规引证与盈亏／赔付率财务背景的情况下呈现给用户**）**；**INV-6 **接地失败即回退**（**当合规检索的接地度低于阈值时，**系统回退到上一版已批准费率表并标记升级，**而不是猜**）**；**INV-7 **审计记录 100% 完整**（**每个决策都产生结构化、**不可变更、**可独立重建的审计记录**）**；**INV-8 **单模块一千行上限**（**`src/` 下的模块不得超过 1,000 行**）**；**INV-9 **单一法域范围明示**（**合规判断明确标注为针对一个示例法域语料，**不声称覆盖多州法律**）**；**INV-10 **核心系统接口是建模与模拟的**（**v1 只建模与 mock 保险公司核心系统接口，**不接真实外部网络**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它把「**不得做什么**」写成了十条有名有姓、**可以被检查的规则**——**⭐ 其中 **INV-4** 与 **INV-6** 直接对应本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」与第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」：**一个会给出费率建议的智能体，**其最重要的功能**可能是**它拒绝发布的那一次**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 阶段表把「**已完成**」与「**计划中**」分开标，**且本次实测对得上**——**逐字阶段 0 至 2 为** ✅ Complete**（**Phase 0 规划与设计：**ML Canvas、**项目章程、**PRD、**用户故事、**技术路线图、**系统设计 ADR；**Phase 1 脚手架与数据契约：**仓库结构、**`uv` 工具链、**`params.yaml`、**两套 Great Expectations 套件；**Phase 2 第一层确定性 ML 基线：**freMTPL2 摄取、**确定性特征、**Tweedie GLM、**合成因果验证、**MLflow 注册表、**展示层**）**，**Phase 3 至 9 为** ⬜ Scheduled**（**有界 Thompson 采样探索走廊、**进程内 LiteLLM 网关与 OPA 式护栏、**法规 RAG 与检索质量评测、**LangGraph 多智能体编排、**人审升级与审计日志、**评测与可观测性加固、**容器化与 CI/CD 收尾**）**。**⭐ 本次实测**：**`src/aegis/` 八个子包中，**`agents`／**`bandit`／**`gateway`／**`governance`／**`schemas` **五个只有 `__init__.py`**；**已建的是** `api/`（**FastAPI 应用、**模型服务、**场景接口、**展示页 CSS 与模板**）、**`pipelines/feature/`（**ingest／exposure／vehicle／driver／pipeline**）、**`pipelines/training/`（**glm_baseline／causal_elasticity／mlflow_tracking**）、**`config/`（**loader／schema**）、**`pipelines/data_contracts.py`、**`expectations.py`、**`cli.py`**；**⭐ 全 `src/` 实测 **2,161 行 Python****。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处是**本轮最值得记的对照**：**README 的阶段表说自己只建到第 2 阶段**，**而文件清单**把它证实了**——**⭐ 即**「**自己声明进度**」这件事**是可以被核对的**，**而这份自述**核对通过****。**⭐⭐ ③ 十条不变量里有一条**用工具强制执行****——**文件清单实测** `scripts/check_module_size.py`**：**⭐ 即 **INV-8**（**一千行上限**）**不是一句口号，**而是**一个脚本**。**⭐ 这与本站第 345 轮「**把平时留在内部的东西拿出来**」同向**：**合规声明若能变成一个检查，**它就从口号变成了机制**。**⭐⭐ ④ 数据契约是**独立的两套套件 ＋ fixtures****——**实测** `data_contracts/` **下为** `elasticity_training_suite.json`、`regulatory_corpus_suite.json` **与** `fixtures/`**；**⭐ 即**训练数据与法规文本**各有一套契约**，**且**带测试夹具**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 报告留在仓库里，**且按阶段分列****——**实测** `reports/docs/` **下分** `architecture/`（**phase_1／phase_2 架构报告与系统设计**）、**`decisions/`（**phase_1／phase_2 实施计划与展示层评估**）、**`evaluations/`（**phase_1 评测报告**）** 等共 **18 份文件**；**⭐ 即**每一阶段的**架构、**决策与评测**都留了文**——**⭐ 这与本站第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 工程工具链可数**：`pyproject.toml` ＋ **`uv.lock`**；**`params.yaml`**；**`dvc.yaml` 与 `dvc.lock`**（**数据版本控制**）**；**`main.py`**；**`launch_app.bat`**；**`Dockerfile` 与 `docker-compose.yaml`**；**`.pre-commit-config.yaml`**；**`.github/` 3 条（**CI**）**；**`tests/` 14 个 `.py`（**分 `unit/`、**`integration/`、**`evals/`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fremtpl2]] 覆盖该数据集**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 覆盖 Tweedie 定价**，**[[governance-mcp]]、**[[aae-ai-act-position]]、**[[frai]]、**[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、**[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 覆盖 AI 治理与监管**，**[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、**[[bandit-risk]]、**[[reliability-harness]] 覆盖决策安全与可靠性**，**[[mlflow]]、**[[great-expectations]] 覆盖实验跟踪与数据校验**，**[[agentic-ai-hack]]、**[[insurancea2amcp]] 覆盖智能体形态**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把十条不变量逐条编号写死 ＋ 把阶段完成度排成表并让文件清单能核对 ＋ 用脚本执行其中一条**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[governance-mcp]] 应当并读**——**它给的是**「**一个会改费率的智能体，**哪些事被事先禁止**」这一份清单**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 把「**不得做什么**」写成**编号可检查的不变量**；**② 把「**做到哪一步**」写成**表格**，**并确保文件清单能证实**；**③ 能把**规章变成脚本**的，**就别只写在文档里**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装依赖、**未跑测试、**未启动 API、**未训练任何模型、**未调用任何大模型**），**故**不主张**其任何功能实际可用**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**按其自述，**七大阶段尚未开始****。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md`、**tarball 路径列表、**`LICENSE.txt` **与 `src/` 下各文件的**行数统计**；**⭐ 未打开** `api/app.py`、**`pipelines/cli.py`**、**`glm_baseline.py`**、**任何测试文件**、**任何 `reports/` 文档**、**任何数据契约 JSON**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 十条不变量**只以 README 的自述形式记录**——**⭐ 本次**未核实**它们是否在代码中真的被强制****（**⭐ 唯一被文件清单证实的是 INV-8 对应 `scripts/check_module_size.py` 与之配套的测试**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实阶段完成度的**内部细节**（**⭐ 例如「**Tweedie GLM**」是否真已训练、**MLflow 注册表是否真有记录、**Great Expectations 两套套件是否真通过**）**；**⭐ 本次只核实了**文件存在与行数分布****。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实「**示例法域语料**」**具体取自哪个法域或哪份文件**（**⭐ **INV-9** 明说它不声称多州覆盖，**但**未指明是哪一个**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** `freMTPL2` **的实际取数来源与版本**；**也未核实**「**合成因果验证**」**的具体口径**（**⭐ 即**因果弹性估计**如何处理混淆**，**本次未读** `causal_elasticity.py`**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** `data/` **是否随仓库提供**（**⭐ 有 `dvc.yaml`／`dvc.lock`，**通常意味着数据由 DVC 管理、**不在 Git 中**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本项目**自述的严谨程度远高于其成熟度**，**⭐ 故条目价值在**设计纪律**而不在**可用性**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核对其合规判断与任何真实监管要求是否一致**；**⚠️ **INV-9** 自己也声明这是示例法域语料**——**⭐ 本条不得被理解为任何监管合规意见**。**⑩ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-13 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-11 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把 AI 治理写成一表编号不变量 ＋ 阶段完成度可被文件清单核对 ＋ 其中一条由脚本执行**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

e.body_hk:
**AEGIS**（GitHub 倉庫 `SebastianGarrido2790/AEGIS`，**逐字全稱** `Actuarial Elasticity & Governance Intelligence System`**）**是一個**受治理的智能體平台****，**README 逐字自述為**「**A governed agentic platform that recommends personal auto insurance premium adjustments by combining causal elasticity estimation, RAG-grounded regulatory compliance validation, and financial impact projection — escalating to a human underwriter whenever a recommendation falls outside pre-approved bounds.**」**，**並逐字寫明設計對象與邊界**「**Designed for actuarial and pricing analysts, underwriting teams, and compliance reviewers as a governed, auditable decision loop — never as an autonomous rate publisher.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-13、最後推送 2026-09-11**、**★0**、**Python**；**許可 MIT**（`LICENSE.txt` 逐字 `MIT License`／`Copyright (c) 2026 SebastianGarrido2790`**）**；**tarball 131 條路徑**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游放進受治理的流程**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[fremtpl2]] 資料集當作**輸入**，**再把結果送進一條**帶人審的決策迴路****。

**可核實資訊（均 README、文件清單與原始碼統計實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 十條「**不可談判**」不變量逐條編號寫死**——**逐字為**：**INV-1 **閘道唯一性**（**任何 agent 或模組不得直接 import 提供方 SDK，**所有大模型調用經進程內閘道**）**；**INV-2 **單一向量庫**（**同一個 Redis Stack 同時充當法規 RAG 索引與閘道語義提示快取**）**；**INV-3 **資料契約具阻塞性**（**訓練資料與法規文本在版本化或入索引前必須通過校驗，**失敗即停**）**；**INV-4 **不為發布而自主**（**輸出止於自動批准或核保人升級，**永不直接寫入生產費率表**）**；**INV-5 **因果輸出只作建議**（**彈性估計與老虎機建議**不得**在沒有合規引證與財務背景下呈現**）**；**INV-6 **接地失敗即回退**（**合規檢索接地度低於閾值時，**回退到上一版已批准費率表並標記升級，**而不是猜**）**；**INV-7 **審計記錄 100% 完整**（**每個決策產生結構化、**不可變更、**可獨立重建的審計記錄**）**；**INV-8 **單模組一千行上限**；**INV-9 **單一法域範圍明示**（**不聲稱覆蓋多州法律**）**；**INV-10 e.body_en:
AEGIS, on GitHub as SebastianGarrido2790/AEGIS and standing for Actuarial Elasticity and Governance Intelligence System, **is a governed agentic platform that recommends personal auto insurance premium adjustments**, described verbatim as combining causal elasticity estimation, retrieval-grounded regulatory compliance validation and financial impact projection while escalating to a human underwriter whenever a recommendation falls outside pre-approved bounds, and designed verbatim for actuarial and pricing analysts, underwriting teams and compliance reviewers as a governed auditable decision loop rather than as an autonomous rate publisher. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-11**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed MIT** with a licence file naming the author and year, and **131 paths in the extracted archive**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream placing an upstream inside a governed process**, since it takes the pooled motor third-party liability dataset as input and routes the output through a decision loop with human review.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the file listing and a line count of the source tree**: **first, ten non-negotiable invariants are written out and numbered**: gateway exclusivity, under which no agent or module may import a raw provider software development kit and every model call routes through an in-process gateway enforcing fallback chains, caching and guardrails; a single vector store serving both the regulatory retrieval index and the gateway semantic prompt cache; blocking data contracts, under which elasticity training data and regulatory text must pass validation suites before versioning or indexing and a contract failure halts the pipeline; no autonomous publication, under which output terminates at auto-approved routine sign-off or underwriter escalation and never publishes directly to a live rate table; advisory causal output, under which elasticity estimates and bandit suggestions are never surfaced without accompanying compliance citations and revenue or loss-ratio context; a fallback on grounding failure, under which compliance retrieval whose groundedness drops below threshold falls back to the last approved rate table and flags an escalation rather than guessing; a complete audit record, under which every decision produces a structured, immutable and independently reconstructable record; a one-thousand-line ceiling per source module; an explicit single-jurisdiction scope, under which compliance verdicts denote an illustrative jurisdiction corpus and never claim multi-state legal coverage; and modelled core-system contracts, under which carrier interfaces are mocked in the first version with no live external network connections. **Writing down what the system must not do, as ten named and checkable rules, is the most copyable item of this round, and two of them — no autonomous publication and fallback on grounding failure — correspond directly to standing project principles that it is better to refuse than to pretend and that a system must not degrade quietly, since for an agent that proposes rates the most important behaviour may be the time it refuses to publish.** **Second, the phase table separates what is complete from what is scheduled, and this entry was able to check that separation**: phases zero through two are marked complete, covering planning and design artefacts, scaffolding with toolchain and parameter file and two validation suites, and a deterministic machine-learning baseline with dataset ingestion, deterministic features, a Tweedie generalised linear model, synthetic causal validation, a model registry and a showcase layer, while phases three through nine are marked scheduled, covering bounded Thompson sampling, an in-process model gateway with guardrails, regulatory retrieval with a retrieval-quality evaluation harness, multi-agent orchestration, the human-escalation gate with audit logging, evaluation and observability hardening, and containerisation with continuous delivery. **The measurement: five of the eight subpackages under the source tree — agents, bandit, gateway, governance and schemas — contain only an empty package initialiser, while what is built is the API layer, the feature pipeline, the training pipeline with a baseline model and causal elasticity and registry tracking, the configuration schema, the data contracts, the expectations and the command-line entry point, with about two thousand one hundred and sixty lines of Python in the whole source tree.** **A self-declared progress table can therefore be checked against the file listing, and this one survives the check.** **Third, one invariant is enforced by a tool rather than by prose**: the file listing contains a module-size checking script, so the one-thousand-line ceiling is a script and not a slogan, which is how a compliance statement becomes a mechanism instead of a promise. **Fourth, the data contracts are two separate suites with fixtures**: one for elasticity training data and one for the regulatory corpus, each with test fixtures. **Fifth, reports are kept in the repository and split by phase**: architecture reports and a system design, implementation plans and a showcase assessment, and an evaluation report, eighteen files in all, so each phase leaves behind its architecture, its decisions and its evaluation. **Sixth, the engineering toolchain is countable**: a packaging file with a locked dependency set, a parameter file, data-version-control manifests with a lock file, a main entry point, a launch script, a Dockerfile with a compose file, a pre-commit configuration, continuous integration, and fourteen test modules split into unit, integration and evaluation groups. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the dataset, Tweedie pricing, artificial-intelligence governance and regulation, decision safety, reliability harnesses, experiment tracking and data validation and agentic patterns, **while this entry supplies a table of ten numbered invariants, a phase-completion table that the file listing can confirm, and one invariant executed by a script. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled decision-safety and governance entries**, because **it supplies a list of what a rate-changing agent is forbidden to do in advance**, and because **three practices transfer directly: write prohibitions as numbered checkable invariants, write progress as a table and make sure the file listing corroborates it, and turn any rule that can be a script into a script rather than leaving it in a document**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependencies installed, no tests, no API started, no model trained and no language model called — **so this entry does not claim that any of it works**, and **it states plainly that, on the project own account, seven of the nine phases have not begun**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README, the archive path list, the licence file and a per-file line count of the source tree were read, and no application module, no command-line module, no baseline model, no test file, no report and no data-contract file was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the ten invariants are recorded only as the README states them, and whether they are actually enforced in code was not verified — the only one corroborated by the file listing is the module-size ceiling, through its checking script and its accompanying test. Fourth, the internal details of the declared phase completion were not verified**, for instance whether the baseline model has actually been trained, whether the registry holds real records, or whether the validation suites pass; **only the existence of files and the distribution of lines was measured**. **Fifth, which jurisdiction the illustrative compliance corpus comes from was not verified**, the invariant stating only that multi-state coverage is not claimed. **Sixth, the actual source and vintage of the dataset were not verified, nor was the meaning of the synthetic causal validation, since the causal elasticity module was not read. Seventh, whether the data directory ships with the repository was not verified**, the presence of data-version-control manifests usually implying that data is tracked outside version control. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and this entry notes that the project documented discipline considerably exceeds its maturity, so its value here lies in the design discipline rather than in usability. Ninth, its compliance verdicts were not compared against any real regulatory requirement, and the project itself states that the corpus is illustrative, so nothing here may be read as regulatory compliance advice. Tenth, the creation date of 2026-08-13 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-11 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that writing governance as a table of numbered invariants, making phase completion checkable against the file listing, and executing one of those invariants as a script had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
